title: [Mar] India's maternal & child mortality — major declines**: Maternal mortality (Lancet) fell ~80% since 1990 — 508→**116**/lakh live births (2023); SRS 2021-23 puts current MMR at 88. Child mortality (UN IGME): Neonatal Mortality Rate down ~70% — 57→**17**/1,000 (1990→2024); Under-5 Mortality Rate down 79% — 127→**27**. SDG targets: U5MR <25, NMR <12/1,000.
